build_vit_model: build a DinoVisionTransformer model with custom embed_dim, depth, and num_heads for vision feature extraction
create_vit_small: create a vit_small Vision Transformer with 384 embed dim and 12 transformer blocks using MemEffAttention
extract_intermediate_layers: extract intermediate layer outputs from a DinoVisionTransformer using get_intermediate_layers with optional reshaping
interpolate_positional_encoding: interpolate positional embeddings in DinoVisionTransformer to support arbitrary image sizes via bicubic interpolation
forward_features: run forward_features on a DinoVisionTransformer to extract cls token, register tokens, and patch token embeddings
